action.body:
Hello new joiners,

Welcome to Acme Retail! Please find a summary of our travel reimbursement policy below:

- Flights: Economy class for trips under 6 hours; premium economy for longer trips.
- Hotels: Up to ₹6,500 per night in metro cities and ₹4,500 elsewhere.
- Meals: Daily allowance of ₹1,200.
- Claims: Submit with receipts within 30 days of return through the expense portal.
- Local Travel: Cab fare for client visits is reimbursed at actuals.
- Advance Requests: Manager approval needed one week before travel.

For more details, please refer to the full policy page.

Best regards,
People Ops Team
